Mark Meek | Mark Meek is an American Democratic politician and real estate agent currently serving in the Oregon House of Representatives.  He represents the 40th district, which covers parts of northern Clackamas County, including Oregon City, Jennings Lodge, Oatfield, Johnson City, and Gladstone.
